newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials shed 150 points, bond losses widen.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials shed 150 points, bond losses widen.

text.p: U.S. blue chips tumbled deeper into negative territory in early afternoon trading on Friday, with the Dow shedding more than 150 points as long bond prices showed few signs of stopping their downward spiral.
The Dow Industrials sank to session lows, losing around 152 points or 1.85 percent, to 8036 as rising bond yields added new life to inflation and rate fears.
The long bond fell 1-8/32 to yield 6.62 percent, hurt by new supply, a weaker dollar, fund selling and technical factors.
The Nasdaq composite lost 28 points to 1597.
